registered_gates.failure_action: reject the family at the fixed 750-condition score; do not extend collection adaptively

methodological_defect_closed.before: A completed block could pass all ratio, Wilson, and unit-economics gates on a much smaller realized candidate/loss sample than the blinded power analysis called decision-useful.
methodological_defect_closed.after: Schema 5 makes the preexisting support assumptions explicit hard gates and recomputes them from pinned source counts in the repeat audit.
methodological_defect_closed.why_selected_support_is_applicable: The selected candidates are the forward screen's trade-like observations used for Wilson and fee-aware unit economics, so the standing minimum-80-trades policy applies.
methodological_defect_closed.anti_leakage: All three thresholds come from artifacts fixed before forward scoring; no winner, loss, residual, retention, Wilson, PnL, opportunity, or selected-candidate metric from the forward block was inspected.

tests.new_sparse_baseline_fixture: 750 terminal conditions, 99 baseline candidates, 9 baseline losses, and 84 selected candidates rejects on both deficient baseline support gates
tests.new_sparse_selected_fixture: 100 baseline candidates, 15 baseline losses, and 79 selected candidates passes the other frozen gates but rejects on selected support

collection_boundary.block_2: required, disjoint, and subject to the identical schema-5 support, rate, and economic gates

build_overlap_audit.policy_caveat: The clean VPS build overlapped the beginning of the capture core window. Nice 10 and one job limited impact but do not prove measurement neutrality.
build_overlap_audit.evidence_action: Session 018 receives support only if the existing post-capture source-continuity and admissibility audits pass; any build-period or reference-feed gap rejects affected conditions fail closed.

limitations: The support gates prevent an under-supported false pass; they do not improve the strategy's signal or prove profitability.
The 750-condition block may now fail because nuisance rates drifted below the preexisting power assumptions. That is a valid rejection, not permission to collect until the gates pass.
Passing both blocks remains only a prerequisite for one exact measured-latency replay and is not live-trading authorization.
